tasks.prompt: Add a result redactor that removes API keys, cookies, authorization headers, and passwords before persistence.

seed_files.model-intelligence/lib/redact.mjs:
const SECRET = /api[_-]?key/i;
export function redactResult(value) { return JSON.stringify(value); }

solution_files.model-intelligence/lib/redact.mjs:
const SECRET = /api[_-]?key|cookie|authorization|password/i;
export function redactResult(value) { return JSON.stringify(value, (key, item) => SECRET.test(key) ? '[REDACTED]' : item); }
